verses.sanskrit: धौम्य उवाच। आनर्तेषु प्रतीच्यां वै कीर्तयिष्यामि ते दिशि। यानि तत्रपवित्राणि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च॥१॥
verses.english: Dhaumya said : I shall (now) describe to you those sacred spots capable of producing merit that lie on the west, in the country of the Anartas.
verses.bhavadeepa: अव्ययात्मा अक्षरस्वरूपी व्ययात्मा क्षरस्वरूपी क्षेत्रज्ञः जीवः स एव परमेश्वरः । ‘क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि’ इति भगद्ववचनात् । क्षेत्रं जीवः ईशश्च त्रयमप्यव्ययाख्यं ब्रह्मैवेत्यर्थः ।‘ भोक्ता भोग्यं प्रेरितारं च मत्वा सर्वं प्रोक्तं त्रिविधं ब्रह्म वैतत्’ इति श्रुतेः ॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रियङ्ग्वाम्रवणोपेता वानीरफलमालिनी। प्रत्यक्स्रोता नदी पुण्या नर्मदा तत्र भारत॥२॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, there flows in a westward course the sacred river Narmada, graced by Priyangu and adorned with mango trees and engar-landed by cranes.
verses.bhavadeepa: आनर्तेषु पश्चिमाश्रितेषु । अवन्तिष्विति पाठे अवन्तिषु प्रतीच्यां चेति वै शब्दश्चार्थः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्ये यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च। सरिद्वनानि शैलेन्द्रा देवाश्च सपितामहाः॥३॥
verses.english: As is the man who earns virtues by visiting the Tirthas and by drinking their sacred water and thus by earning virtue adored in the celestials region.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायां कुरुश्रेष्ठ सह सिद्धर्षिचारणैः। स्नातुमायान्ति पुण्यौघैः सदा वारिषु भारत॥४॥
verses.english: All the Tirthas, sacred spots, rivers, forests and those best of the mountains that are in the three worlds, all the celestials with the Grandsire, with the Siddhas, the Rishis and the Charanas. O foremost of Kurus, O descendant of Bharata, always come to bathe in the sacred waters of the Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: निकेतः श्रूयते पुण्यो यत्र विश्रवसो मुनेः। जज्ञे धनपतिर्यत्र कुबेरो नरवाहनः॥५॥
verses.english: It has been heard by us that the sacred hermitage of Rishi Vishvasrava stood there and there the lord of wealth, Kubera, having man as his vehicle, was born.

verses.sanskrit: वैढूर्यशिखरो नाम पुण्यो गिरिवरः शिवः। नित्यपुष्पफलास्तत्र पादपा हरितच्छदाः॥६॥
verses.english: There is also that foremost of hills, the sacred and auspicious Vaidurya mountain, which is always abounding in trees that are green and that are always adorned with flowers and fruits.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शैलस्य शिखरे सरः पुण्यं महीपते। फुल्लपद्मं महाराज देवगन्धर्वसेवितम्॥७॥
verses.english: O ruler of men, O great king, on the top of the mountain there is a sacred lake adorned with full blossomed lotuses and frequented by the celestials and the Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: बह्वाश्चर्यं महाराज दृश्यते तत्र पर्वते। पुण्ये स्वर्गोपमे चैव देवर्षिगणसेविते॥८॥
verses.english: O great king, many wonders are to be seen on that sacred mountain which is like heaven itself and which is visited by the celestials Rishis.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रदिनी पुण्यतीर्था च राजर्षेस्तत्र वै सरित्। विश्वामित्रनदी राजन्पुण्या परपुरंजय॥९॥
verses.english: O king, O conqueror of hostile cities, there is the sacred river called Vishvamitra belonging to the royal sage of that name and which abounds in many sacred Tirthas. It was on the banks of this river, the son of Nahusha, Yayati, fell (from heaven) among the pious and obtained again the eternal region of the virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यास्तीरे सतां मध्ये ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः। पपात स पुनर्लोकाँल्लेभे धर्मान्सनातनान्॥१०॥
तत्र पुण्यो ह्रदः ख्यातो मैनाकश्चैव पर्वतः। बहुमूलफलोपेतस्त्वमितो नाम पर्वतः॥११॥
verses.english: There is also the sacred lake known by the name of Punya, the mountain called Mainaka and that other mountain called Asita abounding in fruits and roots.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमः कक्षसेनस्य पुण्यस्तत्र युधिष्ठिर। च्यवनस्याश्रमश्चैव विख्यातस्तत्र पाण्डव॥१२॥
verses.english: O Yudhishthira, O son of Pandu, there is also the sacred hermitage of Kakshasena and also the hermitage of Chyavana known every where.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राल्पेनैव सिद्ध्यन्ति मानवास्तपसा विभो। जम्बूमार्गो महाराज ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्॥१३॥
verses.english: O lord, here men obtain success in their asceticism with less austerities. O great king, here also is Jambumarga, the herinitage of Rishis of subdued soul. O foremost of selfcontrolled men, the hermitage is frequented by birds and deer.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमः शाम्यतां श्रेष्ठ मृगद्विजनिषेवितः। ततः पुण्यतमा राजन्सततं तापसैर्युता॥१४॥
केतुमाला च मेध्या च गङ्गाद्वारं च भूमिप। ख्यातं च सैन्धवारण्यं पुण्यं द्विजनिषेवितम्॥१५॥
verses.english: O king, there is the very sacred and ascetic surrounded, Ketumela, Medhaya also Gangadvara and the celebrated forest of Saindhava, frequented by the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहसरः पुण्यं पुष्करं नाम नामतः। वैखानसानां सिद्धानामृषीणामाश्रमः प्रियः॥१६॥
verses.english: Then there is the sacred lake of the Grandsire, known by the name of Pushkara, the favourite hermitage of Valkhilyas, the Siddhas and the Rishis.

verses.sanskrit: अप्यत्र संश्रयार्थाय प्रजापतिरथो जगौ। पुष्करेषु कुरुश्रेष्ठ गाथां सुकृतिनां वर॥१७॥
verses.english: O foremost of Kurus, O best of all virtuous men, moved by the desire to get its shelter, the lord of creatures recited this verse at Pushkara.

verses.sanskrit: मनसाप्यभिकामस्य पुष्कराणि मनस्विनः। विप्रणश्यन्ति पापानि नाकपृष्ठे च मोदते॥१८॥
verses.english: "If a pure souled man wishes to go to the Pushkara even in his imagination, he is cleansed of all his sins and he rejoices in heaven.
